title: The Pass That Wasn't Touched
description: Wren progresses and finds Bellamy. Ellery lets the diagonal pass travel between his legs without a touch; Merrick arrives behind him, controls and finishes with Reid and Arden closing. Original fictional tracking, not a real match reconstruction.

events.label: Wren progresses
events.detail: Wren carries forward while Bellamy offers a wide outlet.

events.label: Merrick starts his arrival
events.detail: Merrick advances from midfield with Arden moving alongside the inside channel.

events.label: The line adjusts
events.detail: Reid stays near Ellery while the back line drops and adjusts toward the ball side.

events.label: Wren finds Bellamy
events.detail: Wren sends the ball out to Bellamy on the left.

events.label: Bellamy collects
events.detail: Bellamy controls on the move as Keene closes the wide lane.

events.label: The low diagonal
events.detail: Bellamy delivers toward Merrick’s arriving route, through Ellery’s position.

events.label: The Pass That Wasn't Touched
events.detail: Ellery opens his stance and lets the same pass travel between his legs without contact or possession.

events.label: Merrick arrives
events.detail: Merrick controls in stride behind Ellery, with Arden and Reid recovering.

events.label: The immediate finish
events.detail: Merrick shoots after a 0.22-second settling touch before the closing defenders reach the ball.

events.label: Beyond the keeper
events.detail: The whole ball crosses inside the posts; Merrick turns as Ellery, Wren and Bellamy converge.
